meta.title: devline
meta.description: devline is my Claude Code plugin: it plans a change test first, implements it in parallel git worktrees with a review per task, and asks for approval twice.
meta.lede: A Claude Code plugin I built that takes an idea to merge-ready code. I approve the spec and the plan, and implementation, reviews and documentation run without prompts.

ogImage.alt: The devline pipeline: seven stages in a row, the implementation stage drawn as three parallel lanes

stages.label: Brainstorm
stages.summary: A few questions about scope and behavior, then the spec. A larger feature is split into phases here.

stages.label: Design system
stages.summary: Only for changes to the UI: design directions as HTML previews, and the one I pick becomes the design system.

stages.label: Plan
stages.summary: Tasks with the files each one owns, its tests and acceptance criteria, ordered in waves.

stages.label: Implement
stages.summary: One agent per task, each in its own git worktree, test first. Every task gets a review. Blocking findings go back to the implementer, and minor ones are fixed together after the last wave.

stages.label: Documentation
stages.summary: README, CLAUDE.md and the docs folder checked against the diff and updated where they are out of date.

stages.label: Deep review
stages.summary: The whole branch built, tested and reviewed for what a single task's review can't see: problems between tasks, regressions, credentials. Every finding is fixed before the merge.

stages.label: Merge or iterate
stages.summary: I merge the branch, or send it back to the plan with what I want changed.

agents.role: Reads the code, traces what a change affects and writes the plan. Asks when a decision is still open.
Implements one task in its own worktree, test first, including build, CI, Docker and infrastructure tasks. Commits only the files it changed.
Checks each task for correctness, security, performance and whether it follows the plan, and runs the tests. On Opus it gives the final review of the whole branch.
Finds the root cause of a bug: reproduces it, gathers evidence, tests two or three ranked hypotheses, then fixes it and adds a regression test.
Proposes design directions as HTML previews, drawn from a curated design database, and writes the design system.
Compares the documentation with the diff and fixes what is out of date, including links and code examples.
Patches CVEs and migrates major versions in one repository, then verifies the build and tests before it commits. Migrations run on Opus.

skills.summary: The full pipeline, from brainstorm to deep review.
Turns an idea into a feature spec.
Writes a test-driven implementation plan from a spec.
Implements the tasks of an existing plan.
The fast lane for a small change: implement, review, commit.
Root cause analysis for an error.
The final merge-readiness review of a branch.
Patches CVEs or migrates a major version.
Designs a single component or a theme.
Creates the CLAUDE.md and the pipeline settings for a project.
Cleans AI patterns out of a draft and flags mistakes, with strict citations for scientific text.
Brand voice, visual identity and messaging.
Logos, icons, banners, slides and corporate identity.
Test levels and the red-green-refactor cycle, for the implementer and the debugger.
Finds what a change to a file can break, for the planner and the reviewer.
The searchable design database behind the frontend planner.
Package manager detection and update steps, for the dependency agent.
Current library documentation through Context7, for every agent.

hooks.summary: Checks every shell command before it runs. Blocks destructive commands and anything that exposes credentials, and asks first before a request that changes something on another host.
Checks reads, writes and edits. Blocks reading private keys and .env files, and writing hardcoded secrets into code.
Puts the pipeline state back into context when Claude Code compacts the conversation, so a run continues where it stopped.
Logs every finished agent, so the orchestrator can rebuild the timing after a compaction.

install.label: From the marketplace
install.command:
claude plugin marketplace add Conava/claude-devline
claude plugin install devline@devline
